visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a red and white racing suit lies face-down on a dirt path, appearing motionless. A white and yellow dirt bike stands parked right next to him. The background features dense green trees and a pale, overcast sky. (2) The camera moves forward rapidly toward the man. A hand enters the frame from the bottom right and shakes the man's shoulder. The man's suit is stained with dirt and mud. (3) The man rolls onto his back, displaying a pained facial expression with tightly closed eyes. He reaches into the chest of his racing jersey and pulls out a red paper scroll. (4) He unfurls the scroll to reveal black Chinese calligraphy while looking directly at the camera with a serious yet comical expression. (5) Animated red lanterns and firecrackers appear as digital overlays at the top and bottom of the frame, accompanied by decorative fan borders. (6) The man rolls back onto his stomach, and the motorcycle's wheel is seen spinning as dust kicks up around him.
